# UsageBreakdown

A range's usage grouped by one dimension, such as by namespace or by model. Drill in by filtering on a row's key.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `from` | `datetime` | The start of the range, in UTC. |
| `to` | `datetime` | The end of the range, in UTC. |
| `groupBy` | `string` | The dimension the usage is grouped by. |
| `sort` | `string` | The measure the rows are ordered by. |
| `total` | [`UsageTotals`](usage-totals.md) | The totals for the whole filtered range. |
| `rows` | [`UsageBreakdownRow`](usage-breakdown-row.md)`[]` | The largest groups by `sort`, descending (then by key). |
| `other` | [`UsageTotals`](usage-totals.md)`\| null` | The groups past the limit, summed; null when there are none. |
| `otherCount` | `integer` | How many groups are summed into `other`. |
